answers.rationale: Each WAL record stores a CRC32 after its payload; read_record_from verifies it and returns an error on mismatch, stopping replay.

answers.rationale: replay_wal reconstructs transaction state from WAL records; without a COMMIT record the transaction is not marked committed, and data operations are not re-applied, so the rows are invisible.
